beats.anchor: « Lui, c'est le Frigo, chuchote Kaydoudou.
beats.extras: The TSV Rheinhafen number 6, nicknamed the Fridge: a huge white German boy of 15, the tallest of his team, shoulders as wide as a garage door, a short brown crew cut, in a navy blue kit with a white number 6, towering over Kaydoudou with a mocking smile. Behind him, other tall German players in navy blue. Behind the brothers, Freddie Shaw, 14, the goalkeeper: a very tall, gangly white English boy (1.80 m) with copper red hair, freckles all the way up to his eyelids, ears that turn red, extremely long arms, wearing two pairs of goalkeeper gloves one over the other, waving them like lobster claws.
beats.outfit: BriBri (14): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion kit with white sleeves with the white number 8. Kaydoudou (13): a head shorter than his brother, round cheeks, soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, in the same kit, holding Mami's ball: an old, slightly misshapen light brown leather ball with a hand sewn square patch of red and yellow wax print and many black marker signatures drawn only as scribbles.
beats.action: In the tunnel, Kaydoudou holds Mami's old patched ball against his hip and whispers to his brother out of the corner of his mouth, eyes sparkling, while the giant German number 6 still looms over him with his mocking smile. BriBri, calm, holds back a smile.
beats.location: A concrete stadium tunnel in north London on a freezing March evening, white floodlight and snowflakes blowing in from the pitch at the far end.
beats.light: Cold white tunnel lights, a bright glow of floodlights and snow at the end of the tunnel.
beats.camera: Low medium shot from Kaydoudou's height, the German towering into the top of the frame.
beats.alt: Dans le couloir, le géant numéro 6 allemand se moque du vieux ballon, et Kaydoudou lui trouve aussitôt un surnom : le Frigo.

beats.anchor: Kaydoudou se relève. Ses jambes crient. Il ne les écoute pas.
beats.extras: Coach Nathan Okafor, 38: a British Nigerian man with a shaved head, very broad shoulders and a big laugh, in a black tracksuit, crouching in the middle of the room, watching with a small spark of hope. Theo, 15: a tall white English striker with short fair hair, his head under a white towel. Tom Whitaker, 15: a tall, broad white English centre back with short brown hair, rubbing his calves and grimacing. Freddie Shaw, 14, the goalkeeper: a very tall, gangly white English boy (1.80 m) with copper red hair, freckles all the way up to his eyelids, ears that turn red, extremely long arms, gloves off, for once without a joke. Jaden Clarke, 15, number 4: a tall, athletic Black British boy with dark brown skin and close cropped black hair with a sharp hairline and Arjun, 14: a slim South Asian British playmaker with neat black hair, sitting exhausted on the bench.
beats.outfit: Everyone in the dark green Kingsbridge Albion kit with white sleeves, muddy and wet with melted snow. BriBri (14): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, number 8. Kaydoudou (13): a head shorter than his brother, round cheeks, soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot.
beats.action: Half-time. The exhausted team slumps around the dressing room, breath steaming. Kaydoudou, who was sitting on the floor against a locker, pushes himself up, legs trembling, one finger raised, eyes shining with an idea. BriBri, sitting next to him, frowns up at him.
beats.location: A small away dressing room in a north London stadium on a snowy night: metal lockers, a wooden bench, snow melting on boots, water bottles on the floor.
beats.light: Harsh white dressing room light, breath steaming in the cold air.
beats.camera: Medium shot from floor level, Kaydoudou rising into the centre of the frame among the slumped players.
beats.alt: À la mi-temps, au milieu de l'équipe épuisée, Kaydoudou se relève, les jambes en feu : il a trouvé l'idée.

beats.anchor: Il saute dans les bras de BriBri, qui tombe à la renverse.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (13): a head shorter than his brother, round cheeks, soft little afro, the gap between his front teeth, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, in a T shirt and shorts with his socks still on. BriBri (14): tall and slim, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, calm eyes, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, in a dark green tracksuit. Papa Armand: tall, short neat beard, warm eyes, a light blue shirt. Maman Estelle: braids gathered in a bun, big gold earrings, a teal and yellow wax print dress under a grey cardigan.
beats.action: Kaydoudou, screaming with joy, mouth wide open, leaps from the bed into his brother's arms; BriBri topples backward onto the other bed, laughing so hard he is crying. Maman, hands flying to her cheeks, laughs. Papa, by the window, smiles with shining eyes as the old telephone on the bedside table starts to ring.
beats.location: A small, plain hotel room near the stadium on a snowy night: two beds with white covers, a bedside telephone, a window with snow falling in the orange street light.
beats.light: Warm bedside lamp light against the blue snowy night outside the window.
beats.camera: Dynamic wide angle shot from the foot of the beds, Kaydoudou in mid-air at the centre.
beats.alt: Dans la chambre d'hôtel, Kaydoudou hurle de joie et saute dans les bras de son frère : Mami prend l'avion pour la finale.
